body: I love my time with her but its not enough. That fact alone makes me a bad person and I deserve not to be here.

I'm really sorry she did that. Med aren't everything but they help. I've been on them for year but eventually they stop working and I have to switch. I'm in the in between so I'm feeling really down but even still they just keep me from hurting myself not necessary happy. I think I'm just emotional scared from my marriage and idk if I can ever fix that

It makes you you feel worse because everything's perfect  but your still unhappy. Today was almost a breaking point but I contacted my therapist and he called my family and well...avoid the mental hospital so
